create_riac_instance: create a RIAC instance with task space bounds and optional hyperparameters for curriculum learning
sample_task_from_riac: sample a task from the RIAC teacher using ALP-weighted region selection and mutation strategies
update_riac_with_reward: update the RIAC teacher with a task and reward pair to trigger region splitting and ALP recomputation
compute_alp_for_region: compute the absolute learning progress of a region by comparing first and second half reward means
split_riac_region: split a RIAC region node into two sub-regions based on ALP difference and population constraints
